Item 2 propagation forward/backward with corrective strokes; item 3 "a `lost` frame is reported as such ... and is NEVER silently filled"; item 4 "`learned` ... when no model is installed it is a typed refusal `model_unavailable` naming the model lane, never a silent fallback to `classic`"; item 5 "The per-frame matte is a matte source of the pipeline of [STU-CMP-033] and enters it at the REFINE stage ... MUST consume the unified edge-refinement surface of [STU-RAS-121] ... MUST NOT define a second edge-refinement record"; item 6 freeze; item 8 "admitted against declared limits BEFORE any allocation"; table: numeric controls "MUST ship as `unknown` per [STU-RAS-106], MUST NOT be clamped".

notes.cache_contract: Propagated mattes are composite's RotoSegmentation / RotoMattes values (temporal::composition::roto), keyed by inputs_digest = SHA-256(canonical propagation inputs from Folio StudioRotoPropagationInputs::canonical_bytes + colour/alpha SHA-256 of every rendered source frame). A host keeps them in its render cache outside Folio and outside the document and passes the segmentation back to propagate_roto (reused when the digest matches); a missing/stale cache is recomputed from the records. Freeze persists only as the record's snapshot (stroke_count prefix, spans, engine, parameters), so a reopened document reproduces the frozen segmentation deterministically.
